name: file-management-system
description: Filequh - Full-Stack File Management System with Next.js, Express & SQLite

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "yellow.bold,cyan.bold" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
